answer: Rule: every identity pays rent to stay alive. Each identity locks 100 units and burns 5 units per epoch as upkeep, so a sparrow of one fake costs 5 units per epoch and 1,000 fakes burn 5,000 units per epoch, linear and endless. A quill of cheap talk earns nothing, and a shale of idle fakes is ground down to zero within 20 epochs. No rent, no seat.
